tldr: FOMC delivered a HAWKISH hold: held 3.50-3.75% but 9-3 with three hike dissents (Hammack/Kashkari/Logan), a terse Warsh statement and 'won't hesitate' on inflation — no September guidance, so September is now a live hike risk for the levered-silver/S-REIT book.
Stocks sold off hard: Dow -2.19% (worst day since Apr 2025), S&P -1.52% to 7,316, Nasdaq -1.74%, VIX +13% to 20.66; the 10Y jumped ~7bp to ~4.64% as the market judged the Fed behind on inflation.
The US-Iran pause BROKE overnight — oil ripped ~+8% (Brent ~$90.7) on renewed strikes and Houthi Red Sea attacks; energy was the lone green sector and the war/inflation premium is back on.

The book's core held as havens: silver ~flat ~$57.5, gold ~$4,029 (above $4,000), BTC ~$64k / ETH ~$1,905 (+1.5%) all resilient while equities fell — a supportive relative signal against the risk-off.

Semis rout extended into a valuation-regime shift: SMH -4%, >$1trn wiped since 24 Jul, Nasdaq 100 in correction; MSFT beat and rose +3% AH on capex discipline, META beat but fell -7% AH on its capex guide.
Next binaries land TODAY: Q2 GDP + core PCE (8:30am ET) validate or fade the hike dissents, then AAPL/AMZN after the close — let them resolve before redeploying the ~3.5-3.75% cash pile.
